title: watch_tests.rs test 6 documents wrong dispatch condition
description: watch_tests.rs::watch_dispatches_frame_without_event_type (line 174-197) asserts that a frame with no event: field is dispatched by watch_once. But watch_once in watch.rs:352 checks event_type.as_deref() == Some("state") only — it does NOT dispatch when event_type is None. SSE frames without an explicit event: line (implied type 'message' per the spec) are silently dropped by the production code, but the test asserts they will be dispatched. The test documents an invariant that does not hold. Trigger: any SSE frame from kithd that omits the event: field causes watch_once to silently drop it while the test asserts it would be handled.
